title: Pulse Width Modulation
lead: Covers lecture 08 and exercise 6: duty cycle and average voltage, how a timer generates PWM (compare match, waveform generator), PWM frequency, the timer modes (normal, CTC, fast PWM, phase correct PWM), registers TCCRnA/B, OCRnA/B, COMnx and WGM bits, the fader (system 15) in C and Arduino, true analog output, and the auto fan exercise. The peer notes do not cover this lecture, so it is built from the slides and the datasheet extract.
